## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the trigger, before/after behavior, and scope using synthetic examples.

## Verification

List commands and results, source/build identity, OS and relevant tool/runtime
versions. Record skipped or unavailable Windows, interactive, and live gates.

## Review checks

- [ ] Reproduction data is synthetic; automated tests make no court requests.
- [ ] This PR excludes court PDFs, client documents, credentials, signed URLs,
      browser profiles, and unredacted client screenshots, including attachments.
- [ ] Contributions are under 0BSD; existing notices are preserved and any
      third-party additions and licenses are identified.
- [ ] Relevant tests pass; dependency/lockfile changes are intentional and explained.

Use [private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/tlfjar/ArcourtDownloader/security/advisories/new)
for security details instead of a public PR.
